The healthcare crisis in this country is a product of failed GOP policies and one that Congressional Republicans refuse to fix. 

The GOP is inflicting real damage on our care economy, our most vulnerable, and the future of healthcare in this country – with no plan to fix it. 

Democrats stand united to make life more affordable for the American people and to cancel the cuts.

Trump and Congressional Republicans didn’t just fail to fix healthcare - they made it worse.

They gutted funding for hospitals and pushed the biggest healthcare cuts in history to pay for billionaire tax breaks. Now Western New York is seeing clinics close, jobs vanish, and care disappear because of their failed policies.

This is what happens when Republicans choose politics over people. I’m fighting to reverse these cuts and make sure every Western New Yorker gets the care they deserve.

Honored to stand with @RepJeffries, @RepHorsford, Rev. Barber, and faith leaders today, demanding an end to this reckless Republican shutdown. 

Families are struggling to put food on the table, pay their utility bills, and afford their skyrocketing healthcare costs – all because Trump and Congressional Republicans would rather protect billionaire tax breaks than the American people. 

This is a moral failure. Republicans must negotiate in good faith and reopen the government.

For months, Congressional Republicans have refused to come to the negotiating table to protect healthcare. They instead chose to shut the government down, turning a blind eye to the crisis their failed leadership created.

Now, the American people are staring over the edge of a safety net cliff with critical programs set to run out and healthcare costs skyrocketing – leaving thousands in Western New York cold, hungry, and without care.

The @HouseGOP has a moral obligation to return to Washington, cancel the cuts, and protect healthcare for the American people.

860,000 New Yorkers are slated to lose their health care because of Trump and Republicans’ Big, Ugly Bill.

The GOP owns this shutdown. Cancel the cuts and protect healthcare. https://t.co/RcfdLfwsv5

November is Lung Cancer Awareness month, a powerful reminder that preventative care starts with access to high-quality and affordable healthcare.

The 60,000 white flags placed on the National Mall represent the 120,000 lives lost to lung cancer this year.

In the wealthiest country in the history of the world, we must commit ourselves to strengthening our healthcare system for every American – not just the ones who can afford it. Protect healthcare, cancel the cuts.

What the Senate has put forward in a backroom deal is a total betrayal of the American people — one that continues an assault on healthcare in this country. 

Millions of people will lose their health insurance, and tens of millions more will be forced to pay skyrocketing costs. It’s a bad deal for the people of this country. I will be voting no.

Now more than ever, we need to keep up the fight to protect the American people's healthcare. 

Today, I stood alongside my House Democratic Caucus colleagues to demand that Trump and Congressional Republicans extend these critical health care tax credits and keep their hands off our healthcare. 

While they continue to push their failed policies that rip away coverage and raise costs for working families, @HouseDemocrats are fighting back to #CanceltheCuts.

I am voting hell no on this bad Republican budget bill that guts healthcare for Americans across the nation and does nothing to lower the cost of living for working families.

Donald Trump and Congressional Republicans continue to break their promise to lower the cost-of-living for the American people and have instead given tax breaks to billionaires, leaving working families to foot the bill.

The fight for affordable and accessible healthcare is far from over.

@HouseDemocrats stand with hardworking Americans, while Congressional Republicans and Donald Trump stand on the side of their billionaire donors. https://t.co/PRHxDfR6Gq

Congressional Republicans and Donald Trump have yet to present a plan to address the healthcare crisis they created that will help the American people. 

The plan they voted into law? It cut Medicaid by $1 trillion, gutted Medicare by $500 billion, defunded the ACA, and raised healthcare costs for working families. 

Every American deserves access to quality and affordable healthcare, and I will stop at nothing to deliver on that promise.

November 16–22 is Medicaid Home and Community-Based Services Week! This week, I’m saying thank you to the caregivers and families who make it possible for people to receive dignified, high-quality care in their own homes. Your work and commitment ensure people can access the support they need to live independently.

At a time when some in Washington are trying to rip that care away, I’m committed to fighting for the health care the American people depend on because everyone deserves the freedom and security that comes with reliable, affordable care.

Nearly 480,000 lives are lost each year in the US from smoking and secondhand smoke. As a healthcare practitioner, I know quitting isn’t easy. It takes time, a plan, and real support.

Today is @AmericanCancer's 49th annual Great American Smokeout - a powerful day to start your journey toward a smoke-free life. You’ll join thousands of people taking an important step to reduce their cancer risk and improve their health.

I’m committed to investing in programs that help people quit, especially in communities facing barriers to care. With the right resources, counseling, and medications, your chances of quitting successfully can double or even triple. Day One starts with you. You don’t have to quit in one day, just start with today.

For New Yorkers looking for help quitting today, call 1-866-NY-QUITS or visit https://t.co/H4y6LLnlPy.

Once again, Donald Trump is attacking the future of our healthcare system.

By cutting loan programs and refusing to recognize essential healthcare degrees like OT and nursing as professional programs, his administration is making it harder for students to finish their education, all while hospitals across the country face critical staffing shortages.

No one should be priced out of helping people. This isn’t just bad policy – it hurts patients, providers, and communities nationwide.

The Trump Administration is continuing its assault on working people and our healthcare system by arbitrarily capping student loans for degrees it deems “unprofessional.” That list includes nurses, teachers, occupational and physical therapists, mental health workers, and more.

As this administration and Congressional Republicans continue to hurt students and American families, I’m standing up and fighting back.

Donald Trump and Congressional Republicans are pushing a cruel policy that guts federal loan access for advanced healthcare degrees – forcing future caregivers into deeper debt and driving even more students away from the professions our communities depend on.

As the only OT in Congress, I know exactly what’s at stake. I’ve seen the burnout, the shortages, and the heartbreaking closures of clinics in places that can least afford it.

We should be investing in the next generation of healthcare workers, not punishing them. House Democrats will fight like hell to protect students, patients, and every community Republicans are leaving behind.

@HouseDemocrats are unified in our fight to extend the ACA tax credits that working families rely on to afford healthcare.

Now that the bipartisan discharge petition to force a vote on the extension of these credits has 218 signatures, @SpeakerJohnson must bring this bill to the floor immediately.

The Big, Ugly Bill is already doing exactly what House Democrats warned it would do – ripping healthcare away from our families and our communities. 

When healthcare facilities close and people go without care, lives are put at risk. 

I will not stop fighting to protect your healthcare.

Read the full story here: 
https://t.co/bnzyni0JoC

Today I was honored to be joined by advocates, leaders, and students to highlight why the LEAP Act is so important to our healthcare system and local communities.

As we approach the New Year, hundreds of thousands of potential grad students are weighing the options of their futures, thousands of whom are looking to dedicate their careers to caring for our loved ones. 

But unfortunately, Donald Trump and Congressional Republicans insist on denying them that opportunity – undermining students, working-class families, and our entire healthcare system. 

We won't sit by while Congressional Republicans and Donald Trump attempt to undermine the very individuals that keep our loved ones safe and our economy running.
